notes:
v0.1.18 — fix lost session when re-opening from taskbar:
- Added single-instance guard. Previously, clicking the taskbar icon while the window was hidden to tray launched a SECOND winmux process, whose startup cleanup killed the running QEMU VM — so your session was lost and a fresh VM booted ('hangs and restarts'). Now a second launch just focuses the existing window; the VM and all terminals stay intact.
